results.question: How many weeks of paid parental leave can I take?
results.prompt_question: How many weeks of paid parental leave can I take?

statements.text: Employee Leave Policy 2026 sets out the leave entitlements available to all permanent and fixed-term employees of the organisation.
Under the Harbour Light leave accrual method, full-time staff earn 1.67 days of annual leave for every month of service.
Personal leave is available when employees are unwell or must care for an immediate family member.
Leave requests are submitted through the human resources portal at least two weeks before the intended start date.
Periods of high operational demand, such as the end of the financial year, may limit the number of people who can be away at once.
